g.text: Full-development fit: training feasibility and final inner guard

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #27313a

g.text: The same 120 original IDs can appear at different stages: left is complete training; right is own-inner predictions, not the same metric.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #27313a

g.text: Retained choices fixed: beta=0.075; eta=0.03 (technical); order=4. Full-fit: execution_review.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #27313a

g.text: Full 120 is in-sample. Passing a complete-training cap does not override the additional same-U B guard or establish deployability.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #27313a

g.text: Two completed simplifications remain failed experiments. Framework retention is a later methodological decision, not retrospective preregistration.
